# Center Samui

> Center Samui Company Limited is a licensed inbound tour operator in Koh Samui, Thailand (head office: 23 Moo 2, Bo Phut, Koh Samui, Surat Thani). It runs tours and ground services in Koh Samui, Phuket, Koh Phangan and Koh Tao, with Hebrew and English speaking staff, for travelers and for travel agents.

- Company registration no.: 0845565012263
- TAT inbound tour licence: 44/00478 (valid 10 Apr 2025 to 9 Apr 2027)
- Email: centarsamui@gmail.com
- Phone (Thailand): +66 82 113 8942
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/israeli_center.samui/
- Website: https://center-samui.com/

## Tours

Koh Samui:
- Zipline (10, 22 or 33 platforms, hotel pickup included)
- Jet ski tours (Samui beaches, Pig Island, Koh Phangan routes)
- Five Islands luxury catamaran with Pig Island (full day, open bar, buffet lunch)
- Pig Island by luxury catamaran (half day, morning or afternoon)
- Horse riding (beach and trail rides, lessons, pony rides for children)
- Buggy tour, 2 hours (jungle, viewpoints, Big Buddha temple)
- Ang Thong Marine Park day trip (speedboat, snorkeling, kayaking, Emerald Lagoon)
- ATV tour (1 or 2 hours, waterfall and viewpoint)
- Elephant sanctuary
- Jeep safari

Koh Phangan:
- ATV tour

Phuket:
- Fishing day trip
- Zipline
- James Bond Island and Phang Nga Bay, 4 islands
- Phi Phi 7 islands day trip

Koh Tao:
- Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan day trip

Full tour details (times, what is included, age and safety limits, cancellation terms): https://center-samui.com/#tours
